title: Globalizing ordinary point-blowup towers from finitely many local schemes
statement: Let $S$ be an integral normal Noetherian scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]; Noetherian here means that $S$ has a finite affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings. Normal means that every local ring is an integrally closed domain. Let $s_1,\ldots,s_r$ be distinct closed points, where $r\geq0$, put $U=S\setminus\{s_1,\ldots,s_r\}$, and set $S_i=\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s_i}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For every $i$, give a finite tower $T_{i,n_i}\to\cdots\to T_{i,0}=S_i$ of ordinary blowups at reduced closed points lying over $s_i$ [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Assume every $T_{i,j}$ is integral and normal. There is a tower $Z_N\to\cdots\to Z_0=S$, with $N=\sum_i n_i$, of ordinary blowups at reduced closed points over $\{s_1,\ldots,s_r\}$. Every $Z_j$ is integral, normal and Noetherian; every arrow is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and is an isomorphism away from its center. The base change of this tower to $S_i$ is the prescribed tower after insertion of identity arrows [def-pc-fibre-product]. More precisely there are integers $a_i(j)$ with $a_i(0)=0$ and $a_i(N)=n_i$; at each global step exactly one $a_i$ increases by one, and $Z_j\times_S S_i\cong T_{i,a_i(j)}$ compatibly with the arrows. Every point $z\in Z_j$ mapping to $s_i$ has a corresponding point $t\in T_{i,a_i(j)}$ and an isomorphism $\mathcal O_{Z_j,z}\cong\mathcal O_{T_{i,a_i(j)},t}$. Over $U$ every intermediate scheme is isomorphic to $U$. If all prescribed centers are singular points, all global centers are singular points [def-weil-regular-scheme]. When $r=0$ or all $n_i=0$, the tower is the identity.
